greeting.en: Jai Jinendra! Welcome to the Louisville Jain Sangh Paryushan companion. Let's get you set up.

ask_language.en:
Which language would you like to use?
Reply 1 for English
Reply 2 for ગુજરાતી

invalid_language_choice.en: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Please reply 1 for English or 2 for ગુજરાતી.

ask_broadcast_optin.en:
Would you like to receive daily Paryushan updates (Pratikraman timings, announcements)?
Reply YES or NO

broadcast_optin_yes_ack.en: Wonderful — you're subscribed to daily updates.

broadcast_optin_no_ack.en: No problem, you won't receive daily broadcast updates. You can still use personal features.

ask_personal_optin.en:
Would you like to use personal features — a fasting (tapasya) log and private reflections?

Please note: Sangh admins can view this personal data through the admin dashboard for community coordination purposes. It is not fully private.

Reply YES or NO

personal_optin_yes_ack.en: Great — you can now log fasts and reflections any time by messaging me.

personal_optin_no_ack.en: Understood, personal features are off. You can turn them on later by asking me.

ask_public_recognition_optin.en:
One more thing — each morning we share the names of those who fasted the previous day in the daily group announcement, as a form of community recognition.

Would you like your name included when you fast? (This is separate and optional — off by default.)

Reply YES or NO

public_recognition_yes_ack.en: Got it — your name will be included in the fasting recognition list when you log a fast.

ask_display_name.en: What name should we display in the recognition list?

public_recognition_no_ack.en: Understood — your fasting will stay off the public list.

invalid_yes_no_choice.en: Sorry, please reply YES or NO.

onboarding_complete.en: You're all set! I'll be here throughout Paryushan (Sept 8-15) for daily updates and to log your fasts or reflections whenever you're ready. Jai Jinendra!

post_onboarding_menu.en:
What would you like to do?
1. Log a fast
2. Add a reflection
3. Log for a family member
4. Daily vow — currently {vow_status}

Reply with a number, or CANCEL to stop a step in progress.

personal_features_off_notice.en: You opted out of personal features during setup, so I can't log fasts or reflections for you. Message the Sangh admin if you'd like this turned on.

ask_fast_type.en: What type of fast did you do? (e.g. Upvas, Ekasana, Biyasana, Ayambil — or describe your own)

ask_fast_note.en: Would you like to add a note? Reply with a note, or type SKIP.

fast_logged_ack.en: Fast logged for today ({fast_type}). Thank you for your tapasya!

ask_reflection_text.en: Please share your reflection — I'll save it privately.

reflection_saved_ack.en: Reflection saved. Thank you for sharing.

ask_family_member_name.en: What is the family member's name? (e.g. a young child or elder who doesn't message me directly)

ask_family_member_action.en:
What would you like to log for {name}?
1. A fast
2. A reflection

Reply with a number.

invalid_family_member_action.en: Sorry, please reply 1 for a fast or 2 for a reflection.

family_fast_logged_ack.en: Fast logged for {name} today ({fast_type}). Thank you!

family_reflection_saved_ack.en: Reflection saved for {name}. Thank you for sharing.

vow_opt_in_on_ack.en: Done — you'll receive a daily vow along with your morning updates.

vow_opt_in_off_ack.en: Done — you won't receive daily vows anymore. Reply 4 anytime to turn them back on.

flow_cancelled.en: Okay, cancelled. Type MENU anytime to see your options.

invalid_menu_choice.en: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Reply 1 to log a fast, 2 for a reflection, 3 to log for a family member, 4 for the daily vow, or MENU to see this again.

agent_error_fallback.en: That's taking longer than usual — it may have already gone through. If you don't see a confirmation shortly, please send it again.

escalation_ack.en: Great question — let me check with the Sangh and get back to you soon.
